shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; sed -n '1,220p' package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs candidates ---'; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '(loading|navigation|link|dynamic|cache|prefetch)' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---'; sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- app/product/page.tsx ---'; sed -n '1,260p' app/product/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- lib/data.ts ---'; sed -n '1,240p' lib/data.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- next.config.ts ---'; sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- instant navigation doc ---'; sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- linking doc ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- loading doc ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 5 \"Suspense|uncached|static shell|immediate|title|page\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md | sed -n '1,260p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- current build ---'; npm run build"
